plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: Pending cases across districts

panels.title: Total pending cases
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Pending cases by district
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly trend of pending cases
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "DOB") AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 districts with most pending cases
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows the current status of scholarship applications across districts. It highlights the total number of pending cases and breaks them down by district. A time series view tracks how pending cases have evolved month by month. The table lists the districts with the highest pending volumes to focus outreach efforts.
